units.source: Launch Bar
units.context: Launch Bar

units.source: Position of the Launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Position of the Launch bar

units.source: On desktop, depending on the layout selected, the launcher bar will either be on the left side of the screen with buttons displayed vertically or at the top of the screen. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Vertical and horizontal layout__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
units.context: Launch Bar > Position of the Launch bar

units.source: On mobile, the launch bar will always be at the bottom.
units.context: Launch Bar > Position of the Launch bar

units.source: If there are too many items in the launch bar to fit the screen, it will become scrollable.
units.context: Launch Bar > Position of the Launch bar

units.source: Terminology__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Terminology

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launcher__TRILIUM_PH_1__: a button that can be (or is) displayed on the launch bar.
units.context: Launch Bar > Terminology

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Available Launcher__TRILIUM_PH_1__: a launcher that is not displayed on the launch bar, but can be added.
units.context: Launch Bar > Terminology

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Visible Launcher__TRILIUM_PH_1__: a launcher that is currently displayed on the launch bar.
units.context: Launch Bar > Terminology

units.source: Configuring the desktop Launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the desktop Launch bar

units.source: There are two ways to configure the launch bar:
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the desktop Launch bar

units.source: Right click in the empty space between launchers on the launch bar and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Configure launch bar…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the desktop Launch bar

units.source: Click on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Configure launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the desktop Launch bar

units.source: This will open a new tab with the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ listing the launchers.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the desktop Launch bar

units.source: Expanding __TRILIUM_PH_0__Available Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section will show the list of launchers that are not displayed on the launch bar. The __TRILIUM_PH_2__Visible Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_3__ will show the ones that are currently displayed.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the desktop Launch bar

units.source: Configuring the mobile launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar

units.source: The launch bar on mobile uses a different configuration from the desktop one. The reasoning is that not all desktop icons are available on mobile, and fewer icons fit on a mobile screen.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar

units.source: To configure the launch bar on mobile, go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Configure launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar

units.source: The configure the mobile launch bar while on the desktop (especially useful to configure more complicated launchers such as scripts or custom widgets), go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → Advanced → Hidden notes and look for the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Mobile Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__ section. While in the hidden subtree, it's also possible to drag launchers between the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Mobile Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and (Desktop) __TRILIUM_PH_6__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_7__ sections.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar

units.source: Adding/removing and reordering launchers__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding/removing and reordering launchers

units.source: To display a new launcher in the launch bar, first look for it in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Available Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section. Then right click it and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Move to visible launchers__TRILIUM_PH_3__. It is also possible to drag and drop the item manually.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding/removing and reordering launchers

units.source: Similarly, to remove it from the launch bar, simply look for it in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Visible Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ then right click it and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Move to available launchers__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or use drag-and-drop.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding/removing and reordering launchers

units.source: Drag-and-drop the items in the tree in order to change their order. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more interaction options, including using keyboard shortcuts.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding/removing and reordering launchers

units.source: Adding a note by drag and drop__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding a note by drag and drop

units.source: To add a note to the launch bar, drag it from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ onto the launch bar. A line between the launchers shows where the note will be placed. If the launch bar is scrollable, hold the note near either end to scroll it. Dropping the note adds a button with the note's title and icon, which opens the note when clicked.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding a note by drag and drop

units.source: Several notes selected in the tree can be dropped at once; they keep their order.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding a note by drag and drop

units.source: A note that is already on the launch bar, or a launcher dragged from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Available Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section, is moved to the new place instead of being added again.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding a note by drag and drop

units.source: The button is a clone of the note in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Visible Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Cloning Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__), so it always shows the note's current title and icon. Right click it and select __TRILIUM_PH_4__Remove from launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to remove the clone; the note itself stays where it is in the tree. If the launch bar is the only place the note is in, it's moved to the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Available Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_7__ instead, so that the note isn't deleted.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding a note by drag and drop

units.source: To list the note's children instead of opening the note, right click the button and check __TRILIUM_PH_0__Show as a folder__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the same way as for a __TRILIUM_PH_2__bookmark folder__TRILIUM_PH_3__. To open the note in a new tab, a split, a new window or a quick edit popup instead of the current tab, right click the button and pick a place under __TRILIUM_PH_4__Open mode__TRILIUM_PH_5__, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_6__Bookmarks__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
units.context: Launch Bar > Configuring the mobile launch bar > Adding a note by drag and drop

units.source: Customizing the launcher__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher

units.source: The icon of a launcher can be changed just like a normal note. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__note icons__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher

units.source: The title of the launcher can also be changed.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher

units.source: Resetting__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Resetting

units.source: Resetting allows restoring the original configuration of Trilium for the launcher bar, or for a portion of it. Simply right click a launcher (or even the entire __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section) and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Reset__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to bring it back to the original state.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Resetting

units.source: Creating new launchers / types of launchers__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Right click either the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Available launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Visible launchers__TRILIUM_PH_3__ sections and select one of the options:
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Launcher__TRILIUM_PH_1____TRILIUM_PH_2__A note launcher will simply navigate to a specified note.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Set the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ promoted attribute to the note to navigate to.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Optionally, set __TRILIUM_PH_0__ to hoist a particular note. See __TRILIUM_PH_1__Note Hoisting__TRILIUM_PH_2__ for more information.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Optionally, set a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ to trigger the launcher.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Script Launcher__TRILIUM_PH_1____TRILIUM_PH_2__An advanced launcher which will run a script upon pressing. See __TRILIUM_PH_3__Scripting__TRILIUM_PH_4__ for more information.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Set __TRILIUM_PH_0__ to point to the desired script to run.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Optionally, set a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ to trigger the launcher.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Custom Widget__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Allows defining a custom widget to be rendered inside the launcher. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Widget Basics__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Spacers__TRILIUM_PH_1____TRILIUM_PH_2__Launchers that create some distance between other launchers for better visual distinction.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers

units.source: Launchers are configured via predefined __TRILIUM_PH_0__Promoted Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Launch Bar > Customizing the launcher > Creating new launchers / types of launchers
